About.heading: About me
About.body: Full-stack software engineer, Holberton School graduate. I built and optimized production systems at American Certification Service, improving site speed by over 20%. I currently develop internal tools with Next.js and Supabase for a law firm, and previously taught full-stack programming freelance.
